# PDF.js 5.6.205

Mozilla pdfjs-dist, Apache-2.0 (see LICENSE). Copied unchanged from the bundled
workspace runtime dependency. Main module, matching worker, CMaps, fonts, WASM
decoders and ICC profiles are served locally; no external CDN or PDF upload service.
Upstream: https://mozilla.github.io/pdf.js/ and https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js

Integration: /js/zynora-disciplinary-pdf.js, first-page canvas preview only.
